Donald Trump registered "Trump Steaks" as a U.S. trademark in August 2006.!5] Trump Steaks were launched on May 8, 2007, exclusively through The Sharper Image catalog, stores, and website as part of a three-month trial period. Trump Steaks were only sold at The Sharper Image for two months before being discontinued.
